```{=html}
<style>
  .rp-lede { font-size: 1.15rem; max-width: 40rem; }

  .rp-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(11rem, 1fr)); gap: 1rem 1.5rem; margin: 1.75rem 0; max-width: 46rem; padding: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: s; }
  .rp-steps li { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: .6rem; counter-increment: s; }
  .rp-steps li::before { content: counter(s); font: 400 13px "Geist Mono", monospace; color: var(--muted); display: block; margin-bottom: .2rem; }
  .rp-price { font: 500 1.6rem/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .rp-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem 1.5rem; max-width: 40rem; margin: 1rem 0 .5rem; }
  .rp-form .full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .rp-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .rp-form label { display: block; font: 400 13px/1.4 "Geist Mono", monospace; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: .25rem; }
  .rp-form input, .rp-form select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; font: 400 16px/1.45 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 0; border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }

</style>
```

::: {.rp-lede}
Show a landlord you earn at least 2× or 3× the rent, straight from your bank's own website. They see yes or no. They don't see your balance, your transactions or your account number.
:::

::: {.rp-notice}
**This isn't built yet.** I'm checking whether enough people want it before I build it. Leave your email and I'll write once, when it works with your bank. Nothing is charged.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="rp-card" aria-label="Example of what a landlord would see">
  <div class="k">What your landlord would see</div>
  <p class="rp-proof"><span class="ok">Yes:</span> monthly deposits are at least 3 × $1,850 rent</p>
  <div class="k">Checked against Chase · account holder name matches · 1 Oct 2026</div>
</div>
<ol class="rp-steps">
  <li>Enter the rent and the multiple your landlord asks for.</li>
  <li>Log in to your bank in a secure window. I never see your password or your data.</li>
  <li>Send the landlord a link. It shows yes or no, and nothing else.</li>
</ol>
<p><span class="rp-price">$9</span> per proof, paid by you. Landlords check it free.</p>
<form class="rp-form" id="rp-form" novalidate>
  <div class="full"><label for="rp-email">Email</label><input id="rp-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required placeholder="you@example.com"></div>
  <div><label for="rp-bank">Your main bank</label>
    <select id="rp-bank" name="bank" required>
      <option value="">Choose…</option>
      <option>Chase</option><option>Bank of America</option><option>Wells Fargo</option><option>Citi</option>
      <option>Capital One</option><option>U.S. Bank</option><option>PNC</option><option>Truist</option>
      <option>Chime</option><option>SoFi</option><option>Navy Federal</option><option>A credit union</option><option>Other</option>
    </select></div>
  <div><label for="rp-role">I'm a</label>
    <select id="rp-role" name="role" required>
      <option value="">Choose…</option><option>Renter</option><option>Landlord</option><option>Property manager</option>
    </select></div>
  <div class="full"><button type="submit">Tell me when it works with my bank</button></div>
</form>
<p class="rp-small" id="rp-out" aria-live="polite"></p>
<p class="rp-small">I keep your email only to send that one note, then delete it. This is a proof you hand over yourself, not a credit check or a background check.</p>
<script>
  // Draft only: no endpoint yet. Before deploy, wire this to a waitlist store (e.g. the site Worker + D1) and count bank/role.
  document.getElementById('rp-form').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var f = e.target, email = f.email.value.trim();
    var out = document.getElementById('rp-out');
    if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email) || !f.bank.value || !f.role.value) { out.textContent = 'Please add an email, your bank and your role.'; return; }
    out.textContent = 'Thanks. You are on the list. (Draft: nothing was sent.)';
    f.reset();
  });
</script>
```
